messages:
Xia Li: heads up — after promoting rw-model-v2-q8 to canary for hosted, we see a regression on multilingual translate tests (CN/JP + Arabic RTL). outputs are dropping BLEU/chrF and emoji handling looks wrong. 😕
Jordan M.: oof. saw any diffs in tokenization stats?
Xia Li: yes. tokenizer split counts jumped for fullwidth punctuation and emoji sequences. example: '你好🙂！' was tokenized as [你好][🙂][！] in fp16 but q8 becomes [你][好][🙂][！] — added extra splits.
Sara K.: can you paste the failing example pair?
Xia Li: src: "请把这个发送给小王🙂。"
Xia Li: ref: "Please send this to Xiao Wang🙂."
Xia Li: fp16 pred: "Please send it to Xiao Wang🙂."
Xia Li: q8 pred: "Please send this to Xiao Wang ."  <-- note extra space / missing emoji glue
Dmitri: that spacing around punctuation after detokenization smells like vocab/index misalignment during quant kernel packing. did the vocab/order change?
Xia Li: vocab.md5 before/after identical. we suspect the tokenizer runtime (fast-tokenizer) when using the quant runtime path is splitting surrogate pairs differently.
Jordan M.: can you run quick tokenization diffs? something like:
```
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('请把这个发送给小王🙂。').tokens)"
```
Xia Li: ran that on canary container image — output (q8 runtime): ['请', '把', '这个', '发送', '给', '小', '王', '🙂', '。'] vs fp16 runtime: ['请把', '这个', '发送', '给', '小王', '🙂', '。']
Sara K.: interesting — q8 splits names and word boundaries more aggressively. could be a different tokenizer library version in the q8 image.
Dmitri: list container diff:
```
- python3.10-tokenizers==0.13.3
+ python3.10-tokenizers==0.13.1
```
Dmitri: 0.13.1 had a bugfix that changed heuristic grouping for CJK+emoji.
Xia Li: rolling back tokenizers in the q8 image to 0.13.3 reduced the regression in our smoke set from -6 BLEU to -0.6 BLEU.
Jordan M.: nice. two action items: 1) pin tokenizers in build image and add in CI exact-version check; 2) add small multilingual golden set with CJK+emoji/RTL combos to the preflight eval.
Sara K.: I'll add the golden set to the eval harness (small 200-sample) and add an alert if chrF drops >1.5 vs baseline.
Dmitri: also file a note in model-onboarding checklist to run tokenizers --version and a tokenization-diffs step.
Xia Li: 👍 also worth noting Arabic RTL issue appears related — same tokenizer change breaks combining marks around Arabic presentation forms, causing diacritics detach.
Jordan M.: assign to @dmitri for follow-up with infra image builds and @sara for eval additions. canary paused for rw-model-v2-q8 until we confirm. :no_entry:
deploy-bot: Canary promotion for rw-model-v2-q8 halted by user request at 2026-03-18T12:04:59Z
Xia Li: thanks all — reopening once pinned images and CI checks are in. I'll post a short postmortem in eng-ml channel after root cause confirmed. :memo:
